question: Do post-return routing, unseen ordered rule combinations and new leaf addresses together require a hierarchy of learned controllers in this assay?
decision: A counterexample suffices. If an ordinary reactive policy or a fitted primitive-table interpreter passes, do not treat passing this assay as evidence for learned meta-control. A failure of one neural baseline has no converse implication.
environment: A mandatory probe returns one of five uniformly balanced private states z after the first call. Four instruction symbols denote random permutations of these states. The required terminal leaf is the semantic role obtained by applying the instruction word in order to z. Leaf addresses are an independently permuted five-slot bank with an explicit role-to-slot contract. Only the selected leaf returns its payload. The controller is assessed on its actual selected address. A common semantic-to-slot lookup is provided to every policy; address invariance is engineered.
data: Five fixed worlds with seeds 17,29,43,71,97. Permutations in each are distinct, nonidentity and pairwise noncommuting. All five z values appear for every word. Training: four singleton words and all two-symbol words (a,b) except b=(a+1) mod 4. Tests: those four held-out ordered pairs, and all three-symbol words for which both adjacent pairs occurred in training. No test labels for fitting or selecting checkpoints.
controls: An optimal pre-return blind policy has exactly 1/5 routing success because each word is a bijection and the private z is balanced. A table predictor fits primitive effects using the shared singleton examples, then interprets the supplied word. It has no learned gate or subcontrollers. Neural baselines: one concatenated-input 2-hidden-layer MLP, and one ordinary GRU cell with shared weights across opcodes. Both see the same post-return z, ordered word and supervision; no intermediate target for multisymbol words. Hidden size 48, fixed seed per world, full-batch Adam lr 0.01, 400 steps, no early stopping.
measurement: Report route accuracy on every case, paired correctness on z and z+1 mod 5, and between-world range. Check all 120 address bindings and label changes under each intervention. The finite suite is exhaustive conditional on these worlds; bank relabelings are not independent trials. Record learned model parameter counts; do not infer equal FLOPs or data efficiency. This is a bounded validity diagnostic, not a benchmark for discovering new primitive skills, inventing a control program from a goal, or realistic tool use.
resources: One school CPU job, no local model, no GPU.
